headline: Ryanair CEO Warns of Record Airfare Surge in 2027 Amid Fuel Costs
summary: Ryanair CEO Michael O’Leary forecast a 20% increase in ticket prices for Europe in 2027 as airlines reel from soaring fuel costs driven by war.
why: Ryanair is one of Europe's largest low-cost carriers, making its pricing forecasts an indicator for the broader aviation and travel sector.

impacts.name: Airlines
impacts.why: Higher ticket prices reflect escalating operational and fuel costs passed on to consumers.
